name: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2021–2024
owner: Autoridad Nacional para la Innovación Gubernamental de Panamá
description: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2021–2024 (AIG / CSIRT Panamá, October 2021). National cybersecurity and critical infrastructure protection strategy of the Republic of Panama adopted by Cabinet Resolution and coordinated by AIG and CSIRT Panamá.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Autoridad Nacional para la Innovación Gubernamental de Panamá (aig.gob.pa) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Autoridad Nacional para la Innovación Gubernamental de Panamá (aig.gob.pa).
